value.rationale: Natural complete exact fixed-three-point Fourier uncertainty on every finite abelian group, with a unique torsion-geometric exception and a nontrivial integral enumeration of all projective extremizing coefficient rays. Resolves a full family beyond previously published odd-prime/Z4-power fixed-support cases; provides explicit mixed-exponent benchmarks for sparse Fourier kernel design. No arbitrary parameter slicing or trivial rebranding is used.
